sentences.text:
Between :
 Ashok Kumar Sarda and another.

... Petitioner
 And
 Allahabad Bank, Himayatnagar Branch, H. No.3-6-435,
 Himayatnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana rep., by its Assistant
 General Manager namely Bs Murthy and another.

This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...To issue an appropriate Writ Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the high handed action of Respondent No.1 Bank in lodging the complaint dated 16.10.2018 before the DCP/DD, CCS,
Hyderabad and registered a case in FIR.No. 90/2019 dated 01.05.2019 punishable under Sections 406, 420 IPC wherein the Petitioner No.1 is implicated and arrayed as Accused No.3 and Petitioner No.2 as Accused No.5, as they are nothing to do with the affairs of the borrower company bad in law, void, abnitio, arbitrary, illegal, violative of principles of natural justice and violative of Articles 14, 19, (1)(g) and 21 of Constitution of India contrary to order dt 16.03. 2016 passed by this Honble Court in WP. No. 3584/2016 in the interest of justice ............"
2. Mr. S. Lakshmikanth, learned counsel for the petitioner, submits that the present petition was filed seeking quashment of FIR No. 19 of 2019.

However, as a charge sheet has since been filed and Ashok Kumar Sarda vs Allahabad Bank on 5 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183565242/
1 the case has been numbered as C.C. No. 5617 of 2023 on the file of the XII Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Nampally, Hyderabad, he prays for permission to withdraw the present petition with liberty to file an appropriate application before the competent Court.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home submits that the matter is presently pending for the appearance of the accused before the trial Court.
4. I have perused the material placed on record.
5. Having considered the submissions made and the limited prayer of the petitioner, the petitioner is permitted to withdraw the present petition with liberty as prayed for.
6. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
